Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

we're Juniper Row at Alder Street market this Saturday. Vale Produce is due between 6:40 and 7:00 a.m.; our stall needs to be ready by 7:30. On the handling note, spinach is marked “keep chilled” and eggs are marked “this end up.” Apples should be Gala, not mixed varieties. Honey is sold by jar, not by case, so count the jars individually.
the driver usually asks us to sign the invoice at unloading. If there is a shortage, damage, or a difference between paperwork and goods, we need to write it on the invoice before signing. Please make the checklist useful while the van is still at the stall, but don't decide which honey count is correct from the notes alone.", "output": "Create a receiving checklist for Juniper Row at Alder Street market for the Saturday delivery from Vale Produce. Use exactly six numbered items, with one practical check per item. Each check must be possible before the driver leaves. Return only the checklist, not an email.

Use these details: the order copy lists four crates of Gala apples, two crates of spinach, one box of eggs, and three jars of honey. The delivery note lists the same quantities except four jars of honey. Apples should be Gala, not mixed varieties. Count honey jars individually, since honey is sold by jar, not by case. The handling note says spinach must be “keep chilled” and eggs must be “this end up.”

The driver usually asks for the invoice to be signed at unloading. Any shortage, damage, or difference between paperwork and goods must be written on the invoice before signing. Do not decide from the notes alone which honey count is correct."}]
